2nd A5 Visa Renewal
I just renewed my A5 visa for 2nd time (2024-2026). after the interview, they printed n sticking my visa on my passport with 1 year validity. I asked the officer about the 2 years validity that I heard, bcs they already stick the sticker tho so I just curious. 

Surprisingly the officer checking the computer and re-prints the visa with 2 years validity. The officer canceled w X marks on my 1 year validity visa she just printed a moment ago and put the new one with 2 years validity. Finally 1 year of break for repeating the yearly visa process. 

📍 Ramat Gan
